bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
umask 077
cd /home/admin1/projects/ai-core
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import pathlib,urllib.request,urllib.parse,html.parser,hashlib,json,subprocess,os
root=pathlib.Path('.ai-core')
assert root.is_dir() and not root.is_symlink()
cache=root/'distillation-wheels'
assert not cache.is_symlink()
cache.mkdir(mode=0o700,exist_ok=True)
name='torch-2.10.0+cpu-cp312-cp312-manylinux_2_28_x86_64.whl'
class Links(html.parser.HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self): super().__init__();self.links=[]
    def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
        if tag=='a':
            url=dict(attrs).get('href','')
            if urllib.parse.unquote(urllib.parse.urlsplit(url).path.rsplit('/',1)[-1])==name:
                self.links.append(url)
index='https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu/torch/'
with urllib.request.urlopen(index,timeout=5) as response:
    p=Links();p.feed(response.read(4*1024*1024).decode())
assert len(p.links)==1
url=urllib.parse.urljoin(index,p.links[0])
u=urllib.parse.urlsplit(url)
assert u.scheme=='https' and u.hostname in ('download.pytorch.org','download-r2.pytorch.org') and u.fragment.startswith('sha256=') and len(u.fragment)==71
expected=u.fragment[7:]
url=urllib.parse.urlunsplit(u._replace(fragment=''))
final=cache/name;part=cache/(name+'.part')
assert not final.is_symlink() and not part.is_symlink()
before=part.stat().st_size if part.is_file() else 0
if not final.exists():
    result=subprocess.run(['curl','--fail','--silent','--show-error','--location','--proto','=https','--proto-redir','=https','--connect-timeout','5','--max-time','15','--continue-at','-','--output',str(part),url],capture_output=True,timeout=17)
    rc=result.returncode
    if rc==0:
        with part.open('rb') as f: assert hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()==expected
        os.rename(part,final)
else:
    rc=0
    with final.open('rb') as f: assert hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()==expected
report={'wheel':name,'before':before,'bytes':(final if final.exists() else part).stat().st_size if final.exists() or part.exists() else 0,'verified':final.is_file(),'sha256':expected,'curl_exit':rc}
body='## CPU PyTorch wheel resumable acquisition\n\n```json\n'+json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n```\n\nOfficial index SHA binding; no global install or GPU.'
subprocess.run(['gh','issue','comment','1','--repo','seigo-gace/ai-core','--body-file','-'],input=body,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=5)
print(json.dumps(report))
PY
